_derived_from: Two complete recorded duels of yugi_pc.exe (data/duel_logs/, recorded with tools/poc_record.py) read against card ids and stats. Record = (op | player<<15, a, b, c). 'seen' = meaning confirmed by matching card names/numbers in the logs; 'inferred' = consistent with the logs but not proven. Card args: 'konami' = Konami id, 'idx' = card number in cards.json.

0x12.meaning: response window / pass priority to the other player (appears after every activation, attack and battle result)

0x61.args: b = count (5 = opening hand, 1 = normal draw)

0xa8.meaning: end-of-turn reset of a monster zone's per-turn flags

0xc4.meaning: Normal Summon / Set a monster from hand

0x92.meaning: summon complete, opens the response window for the opponent

0x91.meaning: flip a set Spell/Trap face-up to activate it

0x72.meaning: activate a Spell/Trap/effect (adds a chain link)

0x08.meaning: choose a target/cost for the activation

0x0a.args: a = zone, b = chain link number

0x78.meaning: card leaves its zone after resolving/being destroyed

0xb5.args: a = src zone<<8 | player, b = 0x0e<<8 (graveyard) | player

0x7d.args: a = konami | flags (0x8000 player, 0x1000 by battle?), b = 0x20 when destroyed by battle

0x56.meaning: Battle Phase: set of monsters that may still attack

0x33.meaning: attack target prompt / opponent's monsters available

0x76.meaning: face-down defender flipped by the attack

0x30.args: a = player 0's monster (idx), b = player 1's monster (idx) or 0 for a direct attack; the record's player bit says who attacked
0x30.conf: seen (both attack directions in the logs fit this; direct attacks only seen by player 0)

0x31.args: b = damage, c flags: 0x400 direct hit, 0x300 face-down/defense defender destroyed with no damage, 0x600 attack-position defender destroyed + damage, 0x0003 seen once when a flipped Hane-Hane (flip effect) was the defender

0x43.args: a = amount, issued by the damaged player

0x42.meaning: Life Points change (other kind: cost or gain)

0x71.meaning: equip / attach (a = equip/new card, b = target konami)

0x72+0x0b on Kuriboh (0xc0, 0xea).meaning: hand trap: discard during damage step (Kuriboh), then damage step re-evaluated

0x86.meaning: continuous effect applied (Spellbinding Circle on a monster)

0x60.meaning: shuffle with CRT rand() seed (from the exe, 0x530ed0)
